attack_surface.boundary: keys at rest and in memory

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: anything against a read-key holder; hiding sizes (TM-R08) or which objects change
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: confidentiality and integrity of every object, ref, index and key file against anyone without the read key

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: freshness for a fresh clone (the host can serve an old but authentic ref); collisions at 48 bits (TM-R07)
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: the host cannot substitute an object: bytes must hash to their id; on every download path since 0.21
